answer: Bind each identity to a one-time biometric liveness check by an independent oracle. The agent shows a live face or voice sample; the oracle hashes it, deletes the raw sample, and issues a signed credential tied to that hash. One human, one credential: a second identity using the same hash is refused at the gate. A forger must recruit a new real person per sockpuppet, about $10-25 each, so a thousand fakes costs $10,000-25,000 before any profit. Honest agents pass once and keep working, like a copper key cut once that opens a whole orchard of doors while the river of cheap fakes runs dry.
